description: This file appears to be a shell script that conducts tests on a Git HTTP backend server, including making HTTP GET and POST requests, checking server responses, and verifying the server's behavior for different repository configurations.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified repository path, captures the response, normalizes line endings, and compares it with an expected output.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with provided data and headers to the specified repository URL, then compares the response with expected status code.

parameters.name: service_type
parameters.description: Type of service, e.g., git-upload-pack or git-receive-pack.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Data payload to send in the POST request.
